# Credit and Semester System (CSS) - University of Kerala

> The official portal for the Credit and Semester System at the University of Kerala, providing comprehensive information on postgraduate academic regulations, administration, and coordination.

CSS at the University of Kerala is a postgraduate academic framework administered from the Karyavattom Campus in Thiruvananthapuram. The system coordinates academic policies, curriculum approval, and admissions for postgraduate programs including M.Phil and PhD studies across the university.
